messages:
sam: Quick thread  proposal for a 'Keyboard-first' compact mode in Prompt Evals. Prototype: https://files.redwood/s/compact-kbd. Questions: should Approve be the first tabbable control in row-compact mode? How does that interact with filter pills and global shortcuts? Need product/design/eng/a11y alignment before we ship.

elaine: Design note: compact rows are already very scan-friendly. Making Approve the first tabbable element helps power users but could be jarring for screen reader users if tab order differs from visual left-to-right. We should keep visual -> DOM order consistent. Proposal: keep filters first in DOM, but add a configurable 'keyboard-first' toggle that moves focus to actions when enabled.

jon: From implementation: adding a keyboard-first toggle is simple if it's just a CSS class + JS focus management. But we need to scope keyboard shortcuts: when toggle on, pressing Enter on a row should trigger Approve; when off, Enter opens row details. Also need to avoid global shortcut collisions.

aria: A11y concerns:
- If we change tab order for keyboard-first, ensure we announce the mode: "Keyboard-first mode enabled" via aria-live when toggled.
- Prefer not to reorder DOM; instead use tabindex=\"-1\"/\"0\" to control focus landing without breaking SR reading order.
- Provide an aria-describedby for the Approve control: "Press A to approve when keyboard-first is enabled".
- Ensure any mode toggle is reachable and persisted per-user.

pasha: From devex perspective: please add a small onboarding tooltip when users enable keyboard-first mode: quick tips + link to shortcuts help. Also consider a small visual badge in the header showing "Keyboard-first" so teams know why tab order changed.

elaine: Microcopy question: for compact mode approve CTA should we use 'Approve' or 'Approve selected'? In keyboard-first single-row flow 'Approve' is fine. For multi-select we should show count on hover or in the sticky action bar.

sam: Decisions for handoff:
1) Introduce an opt-in 'Keyboard-first' toggle in the scorecard toolbar (off by default).
2) Toggle does not re-order DOM; use tabindex switching so SR users keep logical reading order. Announce mode change via aria-live.
3) When keyboard-first is on: first tabbable in row = Approve pill; Enter approves; show small persistent badge 'Keyboard-first' in header.
4) CTA microcopy: single-row = 'Approve'; multi-select uses floating bar with 'Approve selected results' + count chip.
5) Shortcut: A toggles approve on focused row only when keyboard-first is enabled; Shift+A for bulk when multi-select focused.

jon: I'll implement a scoped focus manager and hook up the A/Shift+A shortcuts only when the scorecard has focus. Will ensure tabindex changes don't break SR announcements.

aria: I'll add a quick a11y test plan: verify aria-live announcement on toggle, tabindex flow, screen reader reads controls in logical order, and that shortcut descriptions are available to SR users.

assets-bot: uploaded compact_keyboard-first.png and kbd-onboarding.sketch (https://files.redwood/s/compact-kbd)

sam: Thanks all. Action items: @elaine mocks + onboarding tooltip, @jon spike focus manager, @aria test plan, @pasha add onboarding copy to devdocs. Flag blockers before sprint freeze. :thumbsup:
